title: Oven Roasted Irish Carnaroli Rice Pilaf
description: A spicy and aerated Irish dish featuring Carnaroli rice, miso marinate, and cooked to perfection in a copper pot, this recipe is egg-free friendly and perfect for meal prep. It combines the creaminess of Irish cuisine with the nutty flavor of Carnaroli rice.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large copper pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the miso paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the Carnaroli rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and celery, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Transfer the copper pot to the preheated oven and bake, covered, for 25 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
